About these counts

Stored on this device. Totals count hide events since the last reset, so a later appearance may count again. Recent items keep the latest 500 distinct links. View and engagement values are snapshots from when an item was hidden; items without links appear only in the totals.

“Kept by high engagement” counts X posts that were below your view minimum or minimum likes/views but stayed visible because their likes/views or bookmarks/views reached your keep threshold. They have their own list of the latest 500 links, so they never push filtered items out.
